claim: Flags silent VoiceOver focus stops
sandbox: bundled sample trace; assert the silent-stop finding and element id

claim: Flags adjacent repeated VoiceOver announcements
sandbox: bundled sample trace; assert normalized adjacent announcement and element id

claim: Keeps trace and report files on the user's machine
sandbox: run CLI commands behind a denying proxy; assert no connection and local output

claim: Writes JSON and standalone HTML reports
sandbox: temporary directory; analyze bundled sample; parse JSON and inspect standalone HTML

claim: Excludes intentionally ignored elements from findings
sandbox: bundled sample trace; assert ignored decorative element produces no finding

claim: Records JSON Lines from a scripted runner
sandbox: temporary directory; local printf command; assert ordered trace JSON

claim: Extracts ordered Simulator VoiceOver focus stops from xcodebuild output
sandbox: temporary xcodebuild fixture emits marked and unmarked output; assert only ordered VoiceOver stops are saved

claim: Reports new and resolved findings against a baseline
sandbox: bundled baseline and sample traces; assert new and resolved results

claim: Downloads the browser demo trace as JSON
sandbox: fresh browser at /?demo=1; assert downloaded schema and seven elements

claim: Try it with sample data opens a finished sample report
sandbox: fresh 390px browser; click landing action; assert persistent banner, seven checkout elements, two findings, and reset after download

claim: The landing page recording is generated from the real bundled CLI demo
sandbox: regenerate SVG from the release binary; assert it matches the checked-in self-hosted recording and reports current demo outcomes

claim: Uses the MIT open-source license
sandbox: fresh checkout; assert Cargo metadata and full MIT grant

claim: Rejects input/output and report/report path collisions before writing
sandbox: temporary traces plus hard-link aliases; exercise analyze and diff collisions; assert exit 2 and unchanged SHA-256 inputs

claim: Uses exit codes 0, 1, and 2 as documented
sandbox: bundled traces plus malformed input; assert success, threshold failure, and input error

claim: Leaves no trace after a scripted runner fails
sandbox: temporary directory; run nonzero local command; assert exit 2 and absent output

claim: Builds one local binary with Rust 1.85 or newer
sandbox: fresh build; inspect one binary declaration, Rust minimum, and release artifact

claim: The runnable Simulator example traverses real VoiceOver focus and emits from the app process
sandbox: inspect the shared Xcode project, retained app observer, VoiceOver-enabled assertion, public focus moves and notifications, app-side serialization, UI-test relay, and absence of scripted capture injection or private accessibility APIs

claim: Does not certify Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) conformance
sandbox: inspect CLI help and generated reports for no certification result; assert public boundary wording on site and README

claim: Prints JSON to standard output when --json is omitted
sandbox: temporary traces; run analyze and diff without --json; parse stdout as JSON

claim: CLI demo changes no project files and writes only inside a new temporary directory
sandbox: seed temporary project; hash tree before and after; assert all printed paths share a new OS temporary parent

claim: Detects at least 90% of silent VoiceOver stops with fewer than 10% false positives in the checked-in evidence run
sandbox: run the binary on a 30-stop focus capture; independently derive truth from the separate verbatim speech ledger, retain role speech, and assert true-positive rate >=90% and false-positive rate <10%

claim: Runs every command without an account, credentials, or runtime service
sandbox: clean credential-free environment; run help, demo, analyze, diff, record, and record-xctest fixture

claim: CLI commands send no telemetry or network requests
sandbox: run every subcommand through a recording denying proxy; assert zero connections

claim: Static site stores no data and loads no third-party scripts, fonts, or analytics
sandbox: fresh contexts on every route; assert same-origin resources and empty cookies, localStorage, and sessionStorage

claim: npm run build creates target/release/silent-focus-sentinel and dist/site
sandbox: fresh clone; test runner executes documented build; assert executable binary and routed site output
